participation.context: Conned the speech aloud, and did not call it finished.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the prison was his, this speech is yours

story.body: You spoke the opening of the speech to a window. You stopped before you made the mouth do more than it could. The roll is unchanged.

relations.note: the prison was his, this speech is yours

title: Rehearsed Gaunt at the window as far as the mouth allowed
